title: LoopGuardDecision
description: The loop guard's verdict on one provider call (F-REL-09). Metadata only: no prompt, response or tool arguments, only counts, a cost, and the (tool name, arguments hash) of a repeated call.

runId.description: The root run id the decision is about (see README 'Loop guard').

allowed.description: False only for action stop. fallback and dry_run let the call through.

action.description: allow when no limit is reached, otherwise the policy's action.

breached.description: The first limit reached, in the order max_steps, max_cost, max_wall_time, repeated_tool_call; null when none is.

breaches.description: Every limit reached, in the order above. Empty when none is.

steps.description: Provider calls the run had made before this one.

costUsd.description: Recorded spend of the run before this call, rounded to 8 decimal places.

elapsedSeconds.description: Seconds since the run's first call, rounded to 8 decimal places.

repeatedToolCall.description: The first tool call (in first-seen order) that reached maxRepeatedToolCalls; null when the repeated-call limit is not reached.

targetModel.description: The model to use instead, present only when action is fallback.
